name: A HYMNAL
note: EXTRACTED from docs/118-objects-the-lines.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 245). Do not edit: change doc 118 and re-run. Taken from his pew in the church (errata 246). With it he can stand in the line of mourners on the hill; kept.

LOOK_AT.say: The church's hymnal, with my penciled corrections and somebody's corrections of those.
repeat: A flower pressed at Hymn 41. I have left it where it was. It has seniority.
Held in front of the chest, it makes a mourner of anybody. That is most of what it is for.

LISTEN_TO.say: Pages, when I riffle them. Every hymn goes by in the right key, for once.
repeat: Nothing. It is waiting to be overruled.
The spine, creaking, at the hymn everybody thinks they know.
